use: Complete your account, first steps in a portal.
avoid: A process in a fixed order on one page: use Stepper.
anatomy: Steps (slot) with Checklist item: icon, title, explanation and action.
a11y: Ordered list. The current step has aria-current="step". Done is read out.
do: Hide the checklist when everything is done.
name: Checklist
summary: Onboarding progress: title, progress bar and steps (done, current, open). The current step shows an explanation and an action.
